items.title: Manteigaria

items.title: Sé Cathedral
items.detail: Getting there: Hop on Tram 28 up to Alfama. Explore the historic cathedral and get lost in the surrounding lanes.

items.title: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
items.detail: Climb up for panoramic views over Alfama and the Tagus River.

items.title: Jerónimos Monastery
items.detail: Getting there: Head down to Belém. An unmissable landmark; consider buying tickets online in advance as queues can be very long.

items.title: Pastéis de Belém
items.detail: Sample the famous original pastéis de nata in Belém.

items.title: Cervejaria Ramiro
items.detail: Enjoy a fresh seafood dinner. Reservations are recommended to be booked in advance by yourself.

items.title: Tasca do Chico
items.detail: Finish your evening with live traditional fado music in Bairro Alto.
